<thought>To find the required template, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates whose forward reaction breaks an ester (C–O bond) and forms an aldehyde and an aliphatic alcohol, matching the described DIBAL‑H reduction. I will use the first SMILES from the provided precursor list as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
